p: corresponds to the attribute of Netzach;
are a chariot for the seven attributes,
and Moshe Rabbeinu for the attribute of Netzach,
is a chariot for the attribute of Tiferes,
which is the attribute of truth;
"The lip of truth shall be established forever."
as is said in the holy Zohar (Parashas Ki Sisa).
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that he brought the words of Torah down to earth;
he is a chariot for the attribute of Netzach,
that which has no interruption ever
through the power of the Torah
there is no interruption at all,
even in the present as well.
וְלָכֵן נֶאֱמַר בְּהַפְטוֹרָה זוֹ (יְשַׁעְיָה נא, טז)
Therefore it says in this haftorah (Yeshayahu 51:16):
"And I have put My words in your mouth,
and in the shadow of My hand I have covered you,
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 35a):
who engages in matters of Torah, etc.,
'And I have put My words in your mouth,
and in the shadow of My hand I have covered you.'
and HaKadosh Baruch Hu rejoices with him
and to found the earth,' etc."
"Who are you that you are afraid
and you forgot Hashem your Maker,
Who stretches out the heavens and founds the earth";
"stretches out the heavens and founds the earth"
all the conduct of things is from Hashem Yisbarach,
therefore, "Who are you that you are afraid
of a mortal who will die"
and you will see that he is
only a son of man, a worm,
"And I have put My words in your mouth"
to be among those who engage in Torah,
אִם רַק יִהְיֶה חֵפֶץ ה׳ בּוֹ
if only he will have desire for Hashem
and will thirst for words of Torah;
to put words of Torah into him.
"And I have put My words in your mouth,"
will be in the aspect of
"to plant the heavens and to found the earth,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
as is written in the holy Zohar cited above:
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu rejoices with him
And every single Jew is fit for this,
all wisdom and all the Torah
and does the words of Torah,
all the wisdom and the words of Torah
the fear of Hashem, that is wisdom, etc."
has a portion in the Torah,
"A heritage of the congregation of Yaakov";
'A heritage of the congregation of Yannai'
are designated by the name Yaakov,
"'And to the house of Yaakov their sins'
for in truth every single Jew
has a portion in the Torah,
And "Who are you that you are afraid
And this is a consolation even in the present,
in the midst of the servitude
and cannot occupy himself with Torah,
And since it says "they remove from him,"
it implies that the yoke is already upon him
to occupy himself with Torah study;
when he accepts upon himself the yoke of Torah,
they remove the yoke from him.
"And to say to Tziyon, 'You are My people'";
and in the holy Zohar there:
We went over all of Scripture
'And to say to Tziyon, You are My people.'"
And this is because talmidei chachamim
are called by the aspect of Tziyon,
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת ח, א)
"'Hashem loves the gates of Tziyon,' etc.
that are distinguished in halachah, etc."
"And to say to Tziyon, You are My people":
for talmidei chachamim are called "My people,"
And although the Or Zarua writes
that they are called "am ha'aretz" for this reason
whose inadvertent sins are counted as deliberate,
for this reason they are called "am,"
and do not have so much light;
and nevertheless they are called "My people."
So too, "And to say to Tziyon, You are My people":
even one who is not yet
when they are distinguished in halachah,
they are called "You are My people."
עַל ג׳ דְּבָרִים הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד וְכוּלֵּי
"On three things the world stands, etc.;
and all three are in one pasuk:
'And I have put My words in your mouth'
'and in the shadow of My hand I have covered you'
'to plant the heavens and to found the earth'
but as for what it says,
how are korbanos alluded to in the pasuk?
when we have no altar and no korbanos;
also in the time of the Mishnah
"'And to serve Him with all your heart'
Is there then service in the heart? etc.
Is there then Temple service in Bavel?
Rather, what does it teach by saying
"And I have put My words in your mouth"
for this is the main thing;
he was created for the toil of Torah
And even one who cannot learn,
and this is called toil of speech,
"to plant the heavens and to found the earth"
and it is the aspect of fear;
"They shall fear You with the sun"
And even one who is ignorant
מִכָּל מָקוֹם יֵשׁ לוֹ גַּם כֵּן עֵצָה
nevertheless he too has a way,
which is within reach of every single Jew;
"In the shadow of My hand I have covered you."
This is based on what is said
"HaKadosh Baruch Hu will in the future
make a shade for the masters of mitzvos
within the shade of the masters of Torah,
and this is gemilus chassadim with one's money.
And one who does not have the means
to do gemilus chassadim with his money
is both with one's body and, etc."
And this is within reach of every single Jew,
and "even the empty ones among you
are full of mitzvos like a pomegranate"
And this is what the Yerushalmi says:
"'And to say to Tziyon, You are My people'
is distinguished compared with the nations,
And this is the consolation in the present,
is included among the talmidei chachamim,
"Are you more important to us than it?"
And all of Yisrael are distinguished,
and frees himself for words of Torah,
"Shabbos shall be made entirely Torah, etc."
